analysis:
Examined all four supplied batch analyses and independently checked the replayed recovery policy, readiness diagnostics, capacity hook and added-file metadata. No concrete security regression is established by this evidence. UnauthorizedConnectionRecovery.swift:23–35 requires an idle unauthorized interval and caps exponential retry spacing; lines 42–48 classify recovery candidates without granting permission. ServingReadiness.swift:32–77 reports connection/trust/lease state, and lines 85–164 provide advice rather than executing recovery or modifying credentials. Its hardware/legacy verdicts are diagnostic observations, not substitutes for the common routing gates described in TB-002/TB-011. ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 invokes supervision after awaited maintenance; the supplied hook alone does not establish security-critical expiry enforcement or its absence. No replayed change alters plaintext transport, key custody, cache encryption, billing or privileged-helper authority.
The batch analyses also describe Serve connection bookkeeping, ProviderLoop recovery state, optional daemon-state serialization, fixed logger messages and troubleshooting changes; their supporting source is largely omitted from this replay (21 of 25 reviewed units omitted). These reports are not independent proof of implementation correctness. Remaining material review must inspect ProviderLoop+ServingAuthorizationRecovery.swift and connection-state producers/consumers: confirm idle guards cover accepted/queued work, loading, Autopilot, draining and updates; jitter and retry history survive reconnects appropriately; reconnects clear stale grants/status and preserve native-worker retirement constraints; and supervision remains recovery-only rather than the sole authorization-expiry control. Verify CoordinatorConnection contains no credentials/evidence and readiness is never used as serving permission. These contracts affect A-016/A-018, T-052/T-053, T-057/T-058 and TB-011. Re-registration must not extend retained proof or policy deadlines. Missing implementation evidence leaves these questions unresolved, rather than demonstrating missing controls or clearing the PR.
